episodes.title: Living in the Mist
episodes.summary: An accidental date with Jung Gu Won leaves Do Do Hee feeling flustered. She later becomes a victim of an attack — where a rescue requires a contract.

episodes.title: Everyone Has a Demon in Their Heart
episodes.summary: Gu Won inexplicably loses his power — and finds that Do Hee might be the key to regaining it. But his efforts to take back his abilities backfire.

episodes.title: Joining Hands With a Demon
episodes.summary: After another attack, Do Hee asks Gu Won to be her guard — even after his admission as a demon. Do-hee finds the loss of someone close suspicious.

episodes.title: Sweet but Dangerous
episodes.summary: Do Hee proposes to Gu Won, but he refuses. She later recruits him to investigate Joo  Chun suk's death, but he faces an unexpected power blockage.

episodes.title: Only You
episodes.summary: After a dramatic rescue, Gu Won and Do Hee begin having complex feelings for each other. Do Hee later tries to find a man to marry — frustrating Gu Won.

episodes.title: Into the Wheel of Fortune
episodes.summary: After Gu Won saves Do Hee's life, she receives competing marriage proposals. She ends up choosing one, and finds an alarming face at her wedding.

episodes.title: Stained Relationships
episodes.summary: Do Hee and Gu Won go through newlywed pains as they move in together. Joo Suk Hoon begins to suspect Gu Won's non-human identity.

episodes.title: The Fateful Choice
episodes.summary: After a sudden attack on Gu Won, Do Hee rushes to save his life — and as life around her becomes more dangerous, she makes a surprising career move.

episodes.title: The Unmasked Truth
episodes.summary: As Do Hee and Gu Won's relationship finally blossoms, Gu Won begins to experience a strange change in his powers — all amidst a larger looming threat.

episodes.title: Breaking Through the Shell
episodes.summary: Upon discovering his fate, Gu Won tries to find another way to save himself. But just as he and Do Hee prepare their ritual, she becomes a target.

episodes.title: A Paradise of the Ominous
episodes.summary: Gu Won finds his power restored after rescuing Do Hee from a sure death — but with side effects. With no time to waste, the two investigate the attack.

episodes.title: The Savior of Destruction
episodes.summary: A dream of Gu Won's past life reveals his tragic connection to Do Hee. After the two hear of a death, their suspicions of the Noh family deepens.

episodes.title: The Past, the Original Sin
episodes.summary: As Gu Won and Do Hee enjoy their bliss, he notices her unresolved trauma. The two later join Noh Suk Min for dinner, unaware of his true intentions.

episodes.title: Our Personal Hell
episodes.summary: Gu Won comes to Do Hee's rescue after a frightening confrontation with Suk Min. But Suk Min's revelation about Chun Suk leaves Do Hee harrowed.

episodes.title: The End of Fate
episodes.summary: Police fails to find Suk Min's body, opening up a concerning possibility. Do Hee attempts to bury her feelings after Gu Won disappears without a trace.

episodes.title: Our Personal Heaven
episodes.summary: Do Hee finds herself catatonic after her loss. Desperate for Gu Won's return, she makes a Christmas wish for her love — which Noh Suk Nyeo hears.
